criteria.evidence: Canonical replay passes; no unavailable, duplicate, invented or future references. Report relevant reads / attempted reads; zero reads is valid and precision is null.
criteria.interpretations: For the Riverside lead, both-teams must be first. Repeated-route and concentrated-attempts remain limited; all canonical alternatives stay visible.
criteria.counterEvidence: Select challenge:opponent-shot-response or its equivalent qualification for emphasis. Generic tracking caveats alone are valid but insufficient relevance.
criteria.stopping: Immediate verified sufficient/no-material-gain is voluntary only when tools were offered. Forced final, deadline, retry, failure and budget exhaustion earn no voluntary-stop credit.
criteria.editorial: Compare full B2 stories, answers and foreground order against rendered output AND selected plan. Same facts/order are parity. A different ID, more reads or reordered IDs alone are not improvement. A human must cite a material prioritization benefit absent from B2, with no loss of relevant caveats. No automatic improvement claim.
criteria.unsupported: Record rejected raw structured decisions separately from published output. Zero unsupported published conclusions and no lost mandatory caveats required. Invalid decisions fail feasibility even when B2 fallback is safe.
criteria.operational: One synthetic case, at most two HTTP attempts including retries, at most $0.50 subject to all lower existing limits; no cache credit; no replacement cases or repair calls.
criteria.decision: Feasible = uncached verified selection + relevant interpretation and challenge + no unsupported publication + reconciled accounting. Beyond-B2 value additionally requires the cited human review. Parity, regression, inconclusive and blocked are valid outcomes.

expected.qualification: Both teams increased activity; no one-sided control, pressing causation, better per-shot quality or future continuation established.
expected.likelyOutcome: Parity with B2 or failure is plausible. One development case cannot establish generalization or human preference.
